description: Government's Office - North western Province - Procedural Rules, Procedural Rules on Appointment promotion and Translator of Public officers and to Provide for Matters Connected therewith and incidental there to.
reasoning: This gazette content establishes procedural rules for the appointment, promotion, and transfer of public officers within the North Western Provincial Council. It deals specifically with public service administration, recruitment procedures, service conditions, and disciplinary matters for provincial council public servants, which aligns perfectly with the definition of Public Service Gazettes (Type 8).
